note: Trial answer keys for the norms engine. Expectations are my reading of the instruments (claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-07) - to be confirmed by a planner. 'old' records what /api/rules/at answered for the nearest question, for comparison.

cases.name: 62B Carr St Coogee (R3, 247 m²) - Torrens subdivision into 2 lots, nothing stated about the site
cases.why: 2.6(1) permits subdivision with consent. s 51, s 27 and 2.6(2) prohibit it only if the lot already has a SEPP secondary dwelling / a boarding house / a secondary dwelling being split off - unknown, so asked. 4.1B's 325 m² applies only if a lot is used or proposed for a dwelling house - unknown.
cases.old: subdivision: NOT permissible - Housing SEPP s 51 (reaches the lot)

cases.name: 62B Carr St - Torrens into 2 lots for dwelling houses; no secondary dwelling or boarding house on the lot
cases.why: Permissible with consent (2.6(1)); but 4.1B(2) needs each lot >= 325 m² and 247 m² cannot make two - a development standard, so a cl 4.6 variation, not a prohibition. 4.1(3) does not reach: the lot is not on the Lot Size Map in our copy.

cases.name: 62B Carr St - strata subdivision; no secondary dwelling or boarding house
cases.why: 2.6(1). 4.1 does not apply to strata (4.1(4)(a)). s 185 is only for Chapter 7 pattern-book development - it shows as undecided, never as the reason.
cases.old: strata subdivision: permissible with consent - Housing SEPP s 185 (read as a general grant)

cases.name: 62B Carr St - Torrens subdivision when the lot has a boarding house
cases.why: s 27: consent must not be granted for the subdivision of a boarding house; a SEPP prevails over the LEP's 2.6(1).

cases.name: 62B Carr St - a secondary dwelling (the LEP prohibits them in R3; the Housing SEPP permits them where dwelling houses are permissible)
cases.why: s 52(1) (R3 is a residential zone; dwelling houses permitted) prevails over the LEP's prohibition; s 52(2)'s conditions (no other dwellings, floor area) decide. 53(2)(a)'s 450 m² applies only if detached - the lot is 247 m².

cases.name: 62B Carr St - a 50 m² secondary dwelling
cases.why: Still conditional: the two other s 52(2) conditions are proposal facts the vocabulary cannot hold yet (unparsed) - fail closed, never assumed.

cases.name: Randwick R2, 461 m² - dual occupancy: 4.1C(2) needs a lot of at least 550 m²
cases.why: 4.1C(2): consent must not be granted for dual occupancies in R2 unless the lot is at least 550 m². (Housing SEPP Ch 6 s 166 - LMR dual occupancies - is outside the trial slice.)

cases.name: Randwick R2, 737 m² - dual occupancy: the Land Use Table splits it (attached permitted, detached prohibited)
cases.why: The R2 table row is 'mixed'. Which form is proposed is the asker's fact; the engine must ask, not say no.
cases.old: dual occupancy at this lot: see /api/rules/at

cases.name: Randwick R2, 737 m² - attached dual occupancy
cases.why: Land Use Table: dual occupancies (attached) permitted with consent in R2; 737 m² meets 4.1C.
